cards.t: Binance Suffers $6.3B Security Breach and Hack
cards.b: Binance experienced a major security incident resulting in the loss of approximately $6.3 billion to $6.5 billion. The exchange has suspended withdrawals temporarily while arranging funds to cover losses and cooperating with authorities.

per.BNB: Faced downward pressure following the exchange hack and subsequent wider market selloff.
per.BTC: Slid to around $77,000 amid broader market liquidations triggered by the breach.

cards.label: NEGATIVE CATALYST
cards.missing: Exact timeline for the full resumption of all withdrawal services and complete recovery details.

cards.t: Upbit Sets Deadline to End Blur Trading Support
cards.b: Upbit announced a November 30 deadline to terminate trading support for Blur (BLUR). Holders face potential liquidity impacts once the delisting takes effect.

per.BLUR: Likely to experience liquidity contraction and negative sentiment leading up to the cessation of trading on Upbit.

cards.label: NEGATIVE CATALYST
cards.missing: Specific reasons cited by Upbit for the trading support termination.
